overall_notes: The paper focuses on safety alignment evaluation of Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) through automatic metrics. The NLG task is dialogue generation where models generate text responses to audio/text queries. All evaluation is automatic using safety metrics (ASR, ORR, NSI) and helpfulness score (HS). No human or LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.
